AUTHOR: Connolly
TITLE: Fish surveys on the move: Adapting automated fish detection and classification frameworks for videos on a remotely operated vehicle in shallow marine waters
REGION: Tallebudgera estuary, southeast Queensland, Australia (mixed reef and seagrass, 3 m depth)
SPECIES: Luderick (Girella tricuspidata), yellowfin bream (Acanthopagrus australis); few annotations of Gerres subfasciatus and Ambassis marianus in training only
DATA: Own underwater drone (QYSea FiFish V6) videos, 9 surveys over 3 days in Nov 2021; 237 snippets; 11,714 annotations (train 8,282 / test 3,432); dataset made public
V_EV: Methods: 'We surveyed a mixed reef and seagrass habitat in 3 m water depth'; 'one survey cut short by an increase in turbidity that reduced visibility'
D2: Training: surveys from 2 of 3 days; testing: surveys from remaining day (evaluation set = subset of training set)
D_EV: Methods: 'the training dataset, using snippets from surveys on two of the three days' and 'the testing dataset, using snippets from surveys on the remaining day.'
R_EV: Discussion: 'given the modest size of our dataset, with imagery from consecutive days, and from a single estuary'; 'our model would likely underperform in a novel dataset'
C_EV: Methods: 'We varied CTs between 0-95% in 5% increments.' Fig. 2 precision/recall across thresholds; 'A CT of 40% for both species maximised F1'
E_EV: Methods: 'We tested the performance of models using two key metrics of fish abundance ... 1) count per frame (object detection), and 2) MaxN per video snippet.' Table 3 vs annotated ground truth
ARCH: Detectron Faster R-CNN (ResNet50), Detectron2 Faster R-CNN (ResNet50-FPN), YOLOv5x; Seq-NMS temporal filter
METR: Precision, recall, F1 per frame and for MaxN per snippet; FN proportion; blurriness (Laplacian variance) and box-size distributions of TP/FN/FP
NOTE: Held-out survey day within the same campaign and single estuary -> credited under D (조사일) only; R1=N per P2. PRE mixed: Detectron pretrained on ImageNet-1k, Detectron2 and YOLOv5 on COCO (coded COCO). V5='기타' = Laplacian-variance blurriness per bounding box, compared among TP/FN/FP (descriptive, not stratified performance, so V6=N, V7=N). E4='둘 다': FN proportion of GT reported and FN analysis by fish relative size (box area). Seq-NMS links detections across frames but is not duplicate-count/ID-switch handling (C5=없음). Three replicate models give SE of F1, not per-prediction uncertainty (C3=없음). MaxN compared only with manual annotation of the same snippets.
